answer.rationale: Primary expires in 14 days with no auto-renew, so defer or second-source-only would leave the line uncovered. At 94% volume and no buffer, a full cutover to the low-cost vendor would raise delivery risk even though that quote alone meets the 18% mandate. c4 supports using the competing quote to move the incumbent on price and terms at renewal; c1 supports that staying with the incumbent preserves integration and deliveries. Verifying c4 (how much renegotiation actually recovered) and c2 (whether last year’s low-cost onboarding generalizes to a no-buffer line) before locking. Incumbent concession to a full 18% is not assumed.
